pipeline_state_primitive.observed_behavior: write_pipeline_state serializes a caller-supplied whole dict to a unique sibling temp and commits with os.replace; it has no expected prior digest/revision, state_revision field, CAS rejection, common pipeline-state lock, file fsync or parent-directory fsync.
pipeline_state_primitive.torn_write_scope: The temp+replace pattern prevents readers from observing a half-written destination under an ordinary successful replace, but does not prevent a stale whole-object read-modify-write from replacing a newer complete object.

whole_object_writers.persist_vertical: skills/vertical_select.py reads the entire state, changes vertical/domain/workflow/target/stage-seed keys, then calls write_pipeline_state with the full payload.
whole_object_writers.math_objective: verticals/math/objective_mode.py explicitly documents that set_objective and persist_vertical can race and lose one side's edit; the source intentionally leaves this race alone under its normal-operation assumption.
whole_object_writers.stage_machine: skills/stage_machine.py reads the whole state, mutates current_stage/stages/history and writes the full object. Its advance_stage docstring explicitly says caller identity is not authenticated and advanced_by is free text, while deterministic completion validation protects evidence for forward transitions.

normal_daemon_serialization.manager_pipeline_lock: manager/_session_ops.py implements a cross-process advisory exclusive lock with portalocker on .manager_pipeline.lock and a bounded default timeout of 1800 seconds.
normal_daemon_serialization.daemon_use: daemon/_life_worker_run.py acquires manager.pipeline_lock() around supervisor drain execution.
normal_daemon_serialization.scope_implication: The source does not establish a routine normal-daemon stage race. The concrete exposed surface is whole-object mutation outside a shared pipeline-state CAS boundary, especially setup/admin/direct-library writers or any path not co-held under manager_pipeline_lock.

separate_stronger_control_store.observed_behavior: CampaignControlStore has immutable revision snapshots, state_revision, portalocker serialization, authorization/capability objects, file flush+fsync, and commits HEAD.json after the revision snapshot.
separate_stronger_control_store.not_equivalent: This state_revision belongs to the campaign control store and is not consumed as an expected prior revision by PIPELINE_STATE writes, so it is not currently a pipeline-state CAS token.

tests.pipeline_state_core_test: tests/core/test_pipeline_state.py validates legacy-path migration/precedence and basic reads/writes but does not itself exercise concurrent stale writers, CAS rejection or crash-durability.
tests.no_test_claim_scope: This audit does not assert that no concurrency test exists anywhere in the repository; it records only the exact inspected test surface plus source behavior.

freshness_cross_check.interpretation: The audited low-level pipeline_state primitive is unchanged on both freshly observed public heads. This is current-code confirmation of the primitive only; the sealed C11 candidate remains bound to the original source artifact and commit.

external_precedent.support: The public pgTAP test contract explicitly exercises same-revision concurrency exclusion, attempt-generation fencing, service-role-only completion, stale-revision rejection, late-failure rollback, and exact retry/idempotency behavior in a PostgreSQL transaction.
external_precedent.scope_guard: This is implementation/test evidence for an exact-once transactional invariant in a different PostgreSQL application. It is not an Argus replication and does not prove that a file-backed one-object CAS+consume implementation will have the same crash semantics.

reproducibility_assessment.official_artifact_support: very strong for the diagnosed low-level state/authority gap; absent for the proposed unified mutate_pipeline_state CAS+one-shot-capability implementation because that adaptation is not implemented/tested in the audited Argus source
reproducibility_assessment.independent_replication: No independent Argus implementation/rerun of clean-os-g1-005 identified in this pass.
reproducibility_assessment.judgment: The worker's source-level diagnosis is reproducible: the exact whole-object writer lacks a revision/CAS boundary, independent writers exist, the math writer explicitly acknowledges a lost-update race, stage caller identity is not authenticated at the primitive, and the normal daemon has a separate outer cross-process pipeline lock that narrows the demonstrated risk. The proposed central mutate_pipeline_state boundary is a plausible untested adaptation, not an already demonstrated Argus fix.

supported: Source-observed absence of PIPELINE_STATE CAS/revision/inner lock/fsync at the audited commit.
Source-observed whole-object read-modify-write behavior in vertical, math objective and stage writers.
Source-observed stronger but separate CampaignControlStore revision/capability design.
Source-level current-head persistence of the same pipeline_state primitive on preview and official Microsoft repositories.
External PostgreSQL test precedent for transactional stale-state/fencing/idempotent-retry invariants.
not_supported: A claim that normal Argus daemon stage mutation is currently racing in production.
A claim that an unauthorized writer has been demonstrated to corrupt Argus state.
A claim that the proposed file-backed capability/CAS design is crash-safe or deadlock-free.
A claim that Snaplist's database transaction proves Argus file semantics.

exact_blockers: No implementation of the proposed unified mutate_pipeline_state CAS/capability boundary was found in the audited source.
No matched concurrent-writer test was executed by this audit; source inspection establishes possibility/absence of CAS, not empirical failure incidence.
write_pipeline_state does not expose a durable commit-point contract under power loss; exact file+directory fsync semantics are untested.
Potential lock nesting/reentrancy of a future inner pipeline-state lock must be designed against the existing nonblocking-retry portalocker pipeline boundary to avoid self-deadlock.
Migration completeness matters: a single remaining legacy whole-object writer can still overwrite newer namespace/revision metadata if it is allowed to run concurrently.
exact_next_action: Search the sealed C11 source set for the next candidate whose claimed mechanism has an executable official implementation and materially uncertain replication status; prioritize one where an independent rerun or a concrete failed-reproduction artifact could change evidence strength rather than only confirming source inspectability.
